scope: Bounded documentary curation of all 80 concepts, not a systematic literature review or independent semantic acceptance.

relation_vocabulary.RELATED: A relevant definitional precedent, without equivalence or formal subsumption.
relation_vocabulary.ANALOGY: A pattern or restricted-domain analogy; extension and commitments differ.
relation_vocabulary.CONTRAST: A documented distinction preventing a misleading identification.
relation_vocabulary.NO_DIRECT_EQUIVALENT_REVIEWED: No direct equivalent adopted from the named inspected entries only; not a claim that none exists elsewhere.
relation_vocabulary.NEEDS_LICENSED_SOURCE: Normative adoption deferred; source identity checked, term text unassessed.

prov.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
prov.inspection_scope: Terms listed below only; no PROV conformance or import asserted.

skos.title: SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System Reference
skos.inspection_scope: Concept, scheme and lexical-label distinctions; no SKOS mapping triples asserted.

sosa.title: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology
sosa.inspection_scope: Selected core classes only; observed properties and their specifications remain distinct.

dqv.title: Data on the Web Best Practices: Data Quality Vocabulary
dqv.inspection_scope: Dataset-quality vocabulary used by analogy only. This Note is work in progress, not a W3C Recommendation.

oa.title: Web Annotation Data Model
oa.inspection_scope: Selected motivations and annotation/body distinction only; no serialization conformance asserted.

nist.title: Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments, NIST SP 800-30 Revision 1
nist.inspection_scope: Security-specific terms, selected glossary entries and tables only; not a universal enterprise-risk vocabulary. Glossary entries retain their original attributions.

relator.title: OntoUML specification: Relator
relator.version: Unversioned latest documentation, retrieved 5 November 2026; response SHA-256 retained
relator.inspection_scope: Definition and constraints C1-C2 only; this modeling construct is not the definition of a responsibility mandate.

iso.title: ISO 31073:2022, Risk management — Vocabulary
iso.inspection_scope: Official identity and abstract inspected; normative term text NOT inspected. No exact term or clause number claimed; #78 owns adoption.

mode.title: OntoUML specification: Mode
mode.inspection_scope: Definition and constraints C1-C2 inspected through public indexed full text; direct response returned HTTP 403, so no response-body hash is claimed.

entity.name: prov:Entity
entity.paraphrase: A thing considered through fixed aspects, including conceptual or imaginary things.

activity.name: prov:Activity
activity.paraphrase: An occurrence over time acting on or with entities.

agent.name: prov:Agent
agent.paraphrase: Something bearing responsibility for an activity, entity or another agent’s activity.

person.name: prov:Person
person.paraphrase: A person considered as a provenance agent.

org.name: prov:Organization
org.paraphrase: A social or legal institution considered as an agent.

collection.name: prov:Collection
collection.paraphrase: An entity structuring constituent entities as members.

plan.name: prov:Plan
plan.paraphrase: An entity representing intended steps toward agents’ goals.

revision.name: prov:Revision
revision.paraphrase: A qualified derivation whose result revises an original while retaining substantial content.

role.name: prov:Role
role.paraphrase: A function in an activity-qualified provenance context.

association.name: prov:Association
association.paraphrase: An agent’s responsibility and role in an activity, optionally qualified by a plan.

attribution.name: prov:Attribution
attribution.paraphrase: Ascription of an entity to an agent.

derivation.name: prov:Derivation
derivation.paraphrase: Entity-to-entity transformation, construction or updating represented as a qualified influence.

concept.name: skos:Concept
concept.paraphrase: A knowledge-organization notion; using it does not automatically identify an OWL class.

scheme.name: skos:ConceptScheme
scheme.paraphrase: An organization of concepts; a scheme need not be an OWL ontology.

label.name: Lexical labels
label.paraphrase: A natural-language string associated with a resource, distinct from the resource.

observation.name: sosa:Observation
observation.paraphrase: An act following a procedure to estimate or calculate a feature property’s value.

result.name: sosa:Result
result.paraphrase: A result of observation, actuation or sampling; simple values have a separate property.

procedure.name: sosa:Procedure
procedure.paraphrase: A reusable method describing how observations, samplings or actuations are performed.

observable.name: sosa:ObservableProperty
observable.paraphrase: An observable quality of a feature, rather than a specification describing that quality.

measurement.name: dqv:QualityMeasurement
measurement.paraphrase: Evaluation of a dataset or distribution against a quality metric.

metric.name: dqv:Metric
metric.paraphrase: A standard for measuring a quality dimension; a measurement provides its observed value.

dimension.name: dqv:Dimension
dimension.paraphrase: A dataset-quality assessment criterion associated with one or more metrics.

annotation.name: oa:Annotation
annotation.paraphrase: An association involving body and target resources.

classifying.name: oa:classifying
classifying.paraphrase: A motivation for classifying a target.

describing.name: oa:describing
describing.paraphrase: A motivation for describing a target.

tagging.name: oa:tagging
tagging.paraphrase: A motivation for attaching a tag to a target.

scenario.name: Threat Scenario
scenario.locator: Appendix B, printed B-13, PDF page 63
scenario.paraphrase: A time-partially-ordered grouping of threat events associated with threat sources.

threat_event.name: Threat Event
threat_event.locator: Appendix B, printed B-13, PDF page 63
threat_event.paraphrase: An event or situation with potential adverse consequences.

threat_source.name: Threat Source
threat_source.locator: Appendix B, printed B-13, PDF page 63; attributed there to CNSSI 4009
threat_source.paraphrase: Intent/method or a situation/method potentially exploiting a vulnerability.

predisposition.name: Predisposing Condition
predisposition.locator: Appendix B, printed B-8, PDF page 58
predisposition.paraphrase: A condition affecting the likelihood of threat-related adverse effects.

vulnerability.name: Vulnerability
vulnerability.locator: Appendix B, printed B-13, PDF page 63; attributed there to CNSSI 4009
vulnerability.paraphrase: A weakness susceptible to exploitation by a threat source.

assessment.name: Risk Assessment
assessment.locator: Appendix B, printed B-9, PDF page 59; attributed there to SP 800-39
assessment.paraphrase: A process identifying, estimating and prioritizing information-system-related risks.

assessment_report.name: Risk Assessment Report
assessment_report.locator: Appendix B, printed B-9, PDF page 59
assessment_report.paraphrase: The formal documented output of risk assessment.

response.name: Risk Response
response.locator: Appendix B, printed B-10, PDF page 60; attributed there to SP 800-39
response.paraphrase: Accepting, avoiding, mitigating, sharing or transferring risk.

controls.name: Security Controls
controls.locator: Appendix B, printed B-11, PDF page 61; attributed there to FIPS 199/CNSSI 4009
controls.paraphrase: Safeguards protecting information and systems against security risks.

scales.name: Assessment scale: vulnerability severity
scales.locator: Appendix F, Table F-2, printed F-2, PDF page 78

exposure_note.name: Susceptibility/exposure discussion
exposure_note.paraphrase: Discusses susceptibility/exposure in relation to predisposing conditions.

relator.name: «Relator»
relator.paraphrase: A dependent truth-maker connecting multiple participants through material relations.

mode.name: «Mode»
mode.paraphrase: An individual intrinsic property dependent on one bearer.

concepts.rationale: Reusable risk-pattern content is a managed specification; an intention to carry out steps is not required for every pattern.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Riskium adds boundaries, horizon and objective references to a versioned information specification; PROV Entity supplies no such context schema.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The security source organizes threat events; Riskium records general possible developments about continuing cases, including effects beyond security.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: NIST permits a potential event or situation; Riskium Occurrence requires an actual occurrence, so the source term cannot establish realization.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Risk nature is an objective-relative source claim; a classification motivation alone supplies neither favorable/unfavorable meaning nor truth.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The controlled nature value is an identified vocabulary resource; its label is not its scheme-qualified identity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Riskium permits heterogeneous contextual contributors and opportunities; the security threat-source definition is narrower in subject matter, without a proved class subsumption.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The source allows likelihood to increase or decrease; the Riskium definition selects susceptibility-increasing conditions and does not assert causation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Riskium Trigger is actual and initiating in context; a potential threat event supplies neither actuality nor the initiating interpretation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A potentially harmful event is not its consequence. No direct definition for Riskium’s cross-category outcome boundary is adopted from this inspected entry.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The security weakness account informs one use; the intrinsic-mode interpretation separately requires a bearer. Neither source equates all vulnerabilities with one domain class.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The source links exposure/susceptibility to conditions; Riskium’s timed bearer-to-source situation is a separate authored interpretation, not that note’s formal model.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Considering fixed aspects of an entity does not define the temporal state of a risk situation; the risk-state/workflow distinction remains authored.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A managed documentary identity persisting across versions has additional institution and content conditions not supplied by PROV Entity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: An issued Artifact Version is an entity; prov:Revision describes a derivation, not the resulting version. First issue also need not be a revision.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: PROV permits conceptual entities but gives no policy for identity of abstract meanings; Riskium content equivalence remains application-governed.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: SKOS separates vocabulary notions from their labels and from OWL classes; Riskium additionally manages the documentary resource’s identity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: ConceptScheme informs vocabulary organization; Riskium adds scope and governance/version policies without asserting identical extension.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A classification value is modeled as an identified scheme-qualified resource; it is not a lexical label or automatically an OWL universal.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A classification motivation helps distinguish the assignment statement from its subject; Riskium additionally requires source and context qualification.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The tagging motivation and its lexical content inform use; the Riskium tag artifact and any assignment still require explicit identities.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The record is a documentary entity about one case in this profile; PROV Entity neither imposes that cardinality nor identifies the case with its entry.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: An Entry Revision is a version entity with qualified effective links; prov:Revision is the provenance relationship producing a revision.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Description motivation helps identify a documentary function; the Riskium item has a source and may concern a case, pattern or scenario.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Descriptive content about an outcome does not create that outcome; the source motivation does not supply consequence semantics.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Entity-to-agent attribution can document one part of identification provenance; it is not the full recorded identification, channel or time information.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: An intake channel value is a local vocabulary notion, separate from a real-world contributor to risk; SKOS supplies no specific channel taxonomy.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Description roles are local controlled vocabulary resources; their actual allowed functions are defined by Riskium’s source profile.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A consequence slot preserves the source’s positional vocabulary; no universal consequence ordering follows from SKOS.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Membership organization is a useful information-level analogy; prov:Collection does not turn a register into an OntoUML collective or impose register governance.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Riskium Activity may be only part of an assessment; the NIST process and security scope cannot be equated with every such activity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A security assessment report is a relevant documentary precedent; Riskium information also binds versions, methods, basis and temporal interpretation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A generic information entity does not define a risk-specific assumption/control basis. The basis specification remains authored, with no exact external term adopted.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: DQV evaluates dataset quality; Riskium records a risk-dimension result. A measurement pattern is relevant without equating the assessment domains.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Reusable procedures distinguish a method from an execution; the SOSA domain and Riskium’s risk-assessment interpretation rules differ.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: NIST’s example vulnerability-severity levels illustrate a scale, without defining all permissible Riskium dimensions, units or version-compatibility policies.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A metric-qualified output illustrates how to document a score; Riskium’s numeric risk output is not dataset quality or the risk itself.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: An identified scale-level resource is distinct from both its label and an assessed value occurrence; the scale version supplies interpretation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: DQV’s criterion is modeled as a SKOS concept; Riskium’s vocabulary aspect and its judged result remain distinct from dataset-quality criteria.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Observed/estimated/projected status is local controlled terminology; SKOS does not determine its epistemic adequacy.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A recorded decision selecting a response differs from implementing that response; the security process term does not establish authority or success.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Treatment approach values are controlled resources; their selection and any realization are represented separately.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Intended actions toward a goal are relevant; Riskium adds versioned resources, responsibility, timing and conditions, without asserting full class equivalence.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Actual treatment performance relates to security response actions but is general in domain; a plan does not prove performance or effectiveness.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Security safeguards cover one use of risk control; Riskium permits cross-category contextual measures and separates implementation from effectiveness.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Primary/contingency are locally governed plan-role values; SKOS provides a vocabulary pattern rather than those domain meanings.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Provenance responsibility provides useful agent context; Riskium’s scoped capabilities and accountabilities need a declared mapping, not label-based equivalence.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The human-agent reading is compatible context; formal identity/typing alignment with Riskium Person remains unassessed.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The social/legal institutional reading informs scope; Riskium responsibility and authorization commitments are additional modeling choices.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: A source identifier or description is documentary information; it does not establish an actual agent or resolve the referred identity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: PROV Association attributes responsibility within an activity; Riskium Assignment Information records a claim whose grounding may remain unsupported.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Relator gives the multiple-participant grounding pattern; mandate, temporal scope and responsibility semantics remain Riskium-specific and need semantic judgment.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: An activity-qualified function is useful context; an OntoUML agent role and a grounded responsibility assignment are not identical to a PROV Role value.

concepts.rationale: Approval/issue authority is Riskium-specific; a provenance role or participation does not by itself establish authorization.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Being a person plus a provenance function does not establish the grounded responsible-person role for a particular mandate.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Being an organization plus a provenance function does not establish the grounded responsible-organization role.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Person identity is separate from supported approval authority; PROV does not supply the Riskium authorization policy.

concepts.rationale: Organization identity is separate from supported approval authority; the source offers no Riskium mandate acceptance test.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: The term names a responsibility type; an assigned vocabulary value is not the actual role or the relationship grounding it.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Analysis-progress values belong to a declared local scheme; they do not imply anything about the real-world risk state.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: Processing-status values belong to a declared workflow vocabulary; closure does not establish cessation of risk.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison; no independent human rating recorded

concepts.rationale: An annotation can express information about a target; Riskium additionally records source-qualified record-state claims and available time precision.

concepts.rationale: PROV Role is an activity-qualified function, not the timed record-state situation specified here. No direct external equivalent is adopted from that comparison.

concepts.rationale: An informative signal may arise from results, but is not automatically an observation result or proof of a risk event.

concepts.rationale: Riskium models the managed appetite statement. Exact ISO/Risk IT/COBIT term-level readings require the adopted editions and locators in #78; no normative definition is asserted here.

concepts.rationale: The recorded tolerance statement retains source-specific meanings. Metadata cannot resolve permissible-deviation versus remaining-risk readings or justify a normative crosswalk.

concepts.rationale: PROV Entity does not specify continuing organizational risk-case identity. This scoped source comparison neither proves novelty nor replaces the existing COVER/IRISPortal comparison or independent review.
